answer: Reaching the harbor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the canyon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
